package bad

import "time"

type worker struct {
	now   func() time.Time
	clock func() time.Time
}

func run(w *worker, start time.Time) {
	_ = time.Now()            // violation 1: a bare clock read
	_ = time.Since(start)     // violation 2: Since reads the clock too
	w.clock = time.Now        // violation 3: a field not named now
	_ = worker{clock: time.Now} // violation 4: a key not named now
}
